“What REALLY happens if you shoot for the stars and miss!”— Description

The bloody spacesuit and matching bloody spacesuit helmet (also known as the bloody space helmet) are an outfit set in Fallout 76, introduced in The Backwoodsupdate.

The bloody spacesuit can be claimed as a reward from page 1 of Cryptids from Beyond the Cosmos, the twenty-fourth in-game season, for 40 tickets. The bloody spacesuit helmet can be claimed as a reward also from page 1 of the same season, for 25 tickets.

Once claimed from the season, it can be crafted by the player at an armor workbench.
